items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: Law knows they were way before these kids' time, but they know the tunes

ctx.x: But, now, that was not a young student type, so you'd expect him to play Old Style. He wasn't, no. Well, I mean. I'm surprised that there's that many students that play Old Style.

Well, surprised. You see, the way I figure this, the older people heard this music once before, and it's familiar to them. The newer people, the younger people, hadn't heard it, and it's something all together new to them, so that attracts them. And, well, the surprise is it is. I mean, some of these youngsters, I'd say, 18, 19 years old, can play some of these older tunes. Law knows they were way before these kids' time, but they know the tunes, you know, just as if they were brought up around the tune. They…
Well, I know too much mustard, and I certainly wasn't around when that was popular.
